ZUBY | DÁSNĚ is a dental clinic located in Hradec Králové. We care for our patients using the latest methods, with high-quality equipment and materials. We use a dental microscope or magnifying loupes during examinations and treatment. This enables us to diagnose problems early and provide minimally invasive treatment with maximum precision and care.
Invazivní výkony u nás probíhají vždy be: We always use local anaesthesia for invasive procedures to ensure they are painless. Your satisfaction and comfort are our main priorities. We aim to create a friendly and welcoming environment to help you overcome any worries about visiting the dentist. Our dedicated team will provide the quality care you deserve. We look forward to seeing you!
